case_name: Satya Veer Singh vs State Of Uttarakhand

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Satya Veer Singh, Ghasitu Singh, Attari Devi, Reena, Neetu (husband, father, mother, daughters)

acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Petitioners sought quashing of FIR registered under IPC sections 498A, 323, 504 and 506, and Dowry Prohibition Act. Petitioner's wife slapped him in court.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking to quash a criminal proceeding to demonstrate that the prosecution is malicious or that there are no reasonable grounds for the same.
legal_principles.held: By means of this writ petition moved under Article 226 of Constitution of India, the petitioners have sought quashing of the First Information Report registered as Crime No. 08 of 2013, relating to offences punishable under section 498A, 323, 504 and 506 of I.P.C., and one punishable under section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961, at Police Station Vikas Nagar, District Dehradun.

legal_principles.principle: A party seeking to quash a criminal proceeding must demonstrate that the prosecution is malicious or that there are no reasonable grounds for the same.

outcome.final_order: Urgency Application No. 768 of 2013 is allowed. Interim measure: petitioners' relatives (petitioner no.2 to 5) shall not be arrested.
